messages:
Lina Chau: Heads-up: Opal Systems signed 12-month Dedicated today. Primary contacts: erin@opal.co (IT), sam.ops@opal.co (Platform). They asked for monthly usage exports to finance.

Lina Chau: Immediate asks: provision eu-west Dedicated, SAML/Okta handshake, and a plan for eventual Private/VPC. Kickoff scheduled Tue 10am PT.

Mike Reddy: Nice. Any procurement or security blockers flagged by sales?

Lina Chau: Okta SSO required (SAML); they need attribute mapping. Data residency constraint: all PII to remain in eu-west. They expect bursty traffic: baseline ~20k req/day, spike up to 2000 req/min.

Jess Park: I'll lead onboarding. Need SAML metadata + a minimal runbook for rate shaping and fallback options.

Lina Chau: Uploaded starter Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/CS/Opal+Systems+Activation (contains Okta metadata).

Lina Chau: Okta snippet (trimmed):

Lina Chau: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://opal.okta.com/saml2\">
  <Attribute name=\"email\" />
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Mike Reddy: @Ash can the infra team reserve eu-west capacity and confirm networking constraints for VPC later this year?

Ash Kaur: I can spin up a Dedicated pool in eu-west. Need model selection (family + sequence length) and estimated KV cache. Also need a staging domain for SAML test.

Lina Chau: They plan to use redwood-std-gpt4-open, typical seq len ~1024. I'll paste a sample workload in Confluence.

Jess Park: Action items: 1) Ash open infra ticket to reserve eu-west pool (owner: Ash, due: 3 business days). 2) Sales to provide full SAML metadata + cert (owner: Lina, due: EOD tomorrow). 3) CS (Jess) run kickoff + enablement (owner: Jess, kickoff Tue 10am PT). 4) Finance dashboards: Tara to enable monthly exports and dashboard (owner: Tara, due: next Wed).

Tara Nguyen: I can set up the usage dashboard. Please add Opal billing account ID and grant me billing RBAC.

Lina Chau: Billing account: OPS-9932. Added to Confluence.

Ash Kaur: Creating infra ticket now: ENG-4120 

ENG-4120: Provision eu-west Dedicated pool for Opal Systems. Initial capacity: 4x A100 equiv. Need model config + KV size. ETA 48h.

deploy-bot: ENG-4120 created by Ash Kaur.

Mike Reddy: Risks: Okta cert rotation quarterly (they require automated renewal), potential procurement lag on private networking that could delay Private deploy to Q4. Recommend fallback plan: hosted API + encrypted tunnels while Private is provisioned.

Jess Park: I'll draft fallback runbook for hosted pre-auth flows and outline expected SLA tradeoffs. Also creating a 2-week enablement feedback survey to capture latency and billing clarity.

Lina Chau: Opal also asked for cost-optimization guidance (batching + KV) to reduce token spend during spikes. Ash / eng: can you propose an initial batching config for 2k/min spikes?

Ash Kaur: Yes. Suggested initial config: max_batch=32, max_latency_ms=50, kv_cache_size=8GB. I'll attach JSON to ENG-4120.

Ash Kaur: ```json
{
  \"max_batch\": 32,
  \"max_latency_ms\": 50,
  \"kv_cache_size\": \"8GB\"
}
```

Mike Reddy: Also request: CS to collect enablement feedback in first 2 weeks and review with Product in week 3. Jess, can you own that?

Jess Park: On it. Survey will ask about onboarding clarity, latency satisfaction, billing visibility, and docs/gaps. I'll set calendar reminders.

Tara Nguyen: Marking billing tasks in my queue. Will reach out for RBAC.

Jess Park: Assigning CS pre-kickoff checklist to Opal thread and sharing calendar invite.

Mike Reddy: Closing loop: if any blocker arises, ping #eng-oncall and tag me.

Lina Chau: Thanks team 680. I'll post Okta cert tomorrow and update Confluence with owners.
